name: THMY Holdings Berhad
overview: THMY Holdings Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE Market 完成首次公开募股（IPO），并推行员工股份认购计划（ESOS）。公司业务线未出现扩张、缩减或出售的公告，亦未公布新合约。
overview_en: THMY Holdings Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026 and implemented an employees' share option scheme (ESOS). There were no announcements of business line expansion, reduction, or divestment, nor any new contracts.
